mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% annualized signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL growth exceeds 2.5% annualized.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which historically leads to wage inflation and increased corporate costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE is below 4%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) above its 12-month moving average signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where RSAFS exceeds its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) for three consecutive months signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising FEDFUNDS and falling CPIAUCSL signals a monetary tightening cycle with disinflationary pressure, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS increases by > 0.25% and CPIAUCSL increases by < 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) coupled with a decrease in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) signals a robust labor market, boosting consumer confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where PAYEMS > 200k and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) signals a strengthening housing market, which boosts related industries and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where HOUST shows sustained increase.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in GDP (GDPC1) coupled with an increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) signals a shift towards service-oriented growth, which benefits technology and consumer sectors, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 < previous quarter and INDPRO > previous month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where GDPC1 declines and INDPRO increases.
